details:
I am experiencing a severe issue with my microphone while playing VRChat on my Android device (POCO F6 Pro).

The game runs perfectly fine with no performance or FPS drops, BUT I have the following issue with the audio:

When I join an instance, the microphone works normally for about the first two minutes. After that, it starts to "crackle," lag severely, and freeze. For example, a phrase that takes me 10 seconds to say gets transmitted in just a couple of seconds as a heavily lagging, broken, and chopped-up voice.

I have tried EVERY possible solution on my own, but nothing worked:

Tested different microphones: Built-in phone mic, wired PC headsets, standard wired earphones, and Bluetooth headphones. The issue persists across all of them, even though they work perfectly fine in all other games and apps.

Basic troubleshooting: Reinstalled the game, cleared the cache, revoked and re-granted microphone permissions for the VRChat app, updated the OS, and rebooted the device.

In-game settings: Explored the in-game microphone settings, tried adjusting the voice activation threshold (mic toggle), and tweaked various sliders.

Nothing has helped so far. I would really appreciate your assistance in resolving this issue, as it makes communication in the game impossible.
title: Microphone issues on Android (POCO F6 Pro) - Voice lagging and crackling
